snippet.title: The Knight's Challenge | Game Trailer
snippet.description:
You are locked in a tower room of a castle.
Get ready for a point-and-click adventure about knights and castles. In this casual escape room game you have to find all the clues to solve a series of puzzles. Only if you solve all the puzzles will you be able to escape the tower room.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

Buy The Knight's Challenge on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4259020/The_Knights_Challenge/ 
Buy The Knight's Challenge on itch.io: https://esciri.itch.io/the-knights-challenge
More information: https://esciri.com/escaperooms/the-knights-challenge/ 
Hints for The Knight's Challenge: https://esciri.com/escaperooms/the-knights-challenge/hints-the-knights-challenge/
